items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 21:1
items.html: (To the question) For Aba and Ima are always in the aspect of a single stature, and permanently they are in the stature of SAG, which is the aspect of the Bina of AA that went out beyond the head of AA. And by the ascent of the MAN of ZA, the Bina of AA returns to the head, and then Aba and Ima also ascend to the aspect of the GAR of AA. And they emerge together means: at the time that Bina emerged from the head of AA, then both of them also emerged from the head of AA, and they are in the aspect of SAG. And they abide together means: at the time of the return of Bina to its head, they also ascend to the head of AA and both acquire the stature of AB. Thus their stature is always equal, for they are always a single stature.
